caption:
Keep failing in the same place? He keeps calling you back anyway. (Amos 4:6 devotional)

The refrain sounds like wrath, but it's a door He keeps holding open. He calls you again, as many times as it takes.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Where have I fallen so many times I assume God is done calling?
